# <b>Industrial Engineering Curriculum Flow Chart, 2017</b>

Industrial Engineering curriculum flowchart organized by semester, showing course prerequisites and elective options. Asterisks identify courses requiring a C or better and a minimum GPA of 2.25 to take professional courses; double asterisks identify courses requiring Engineering Professional Program acceptance; triple asterisks identify courses requiring approval.

- Freshman Fall Semester — 16 Hours
  - ENGR 1300* — Engineering Problem Solving
  - IE 1205* — Introduction to Industrial Engineering
  - MATH 1426* — Calculus I
  - CHEM 1441* — General Chemistry I with Lab
  - ENGL 1301* — Rhetoric & Composition I
- Freshman Spring Semester — 18 Hours
  - IE 2305* — Computers & IE
  - MAE 1351* — Engineering Graphics
  - MATH 2425* — Calculus II
  - CHEM 1442* — General Chemistry II with Lab
  - PHYS 1443* — Physics I with Lab
- Sophomore Fall Semester — 16 Hours
  - HIST 1311 — US to 1865
  - MATH 2326* — Calculus III
  - IE 2308* — Engineering Economics
  - PHYS 1444* — Physics II with Lab
  - COMS 2302 — Professional & Technical Communication
- Sophomore Spring Semester — 15 Hours
  - HIST 1312 — US post 1865
  - POLS 2312 — State & Local Government
  - IE 3301* — Engineering Probability
  - IE 3315* — Operations Research I
  - MATH 3319* — Differential Equations
- Junior** Fall Semester — 15 Hours
  - IE 3314 — Engineering Research Methods
  - IE 3343 — Methods & Standards
  - IE 4315 — Operations Research II
  - IE 4303 — Production & Inventory Control
  - Language, Philosophy, & Cultural Elective *** — 3 Hrs
- Junior** Spring Semester — 18 Hours
  - IE 4322 — Enterprise Simulation
  - IE 4344 — Human Factors Engineering
  - IE 4340 — Engineering Project Management
  - IE 4302 — Engineering Administration & Organization
  - Technical Elective *** — 3 Hrs
  - POLS 2311 — Government of US
- Senior** Fall Semester — 15 Hours
  - IE 4308 — Quality Systems
  - IE 4343 — Facilities Planning & Design
  - IE 4325 — Automation & Robotics
  - IE 4339** — Production Development, Producibility and Design
  - Technical Elective *** — 3 Hrs
- Senior** Spring Semester — 15 Hours
  - IE 4318 — Enterprise Design
  - IE 4345 — Knowledge & Technology Management
  - IE 4350 — IE Capstone Design; Prereq or Coreq: all 4000 level classes
  - Creative Arts Elective *** — 3 Hrs
  - Technical Elective *** — 3 Hrs
